disease_description: Our AI has detected clear signs of Paddy Blast disease. Immediate treatment is recommended.
disease_overview_text: Paddy Blast is a fungal disease that affects rice crops. It spreads quickly in humid conditions and can severely reduce yield.
water_management_text:
• Maintain proper drainage
• Avoid excessive irrigation
• Keep water level around 2-3cm
• Reduce humidity around plants
fertilizer_recommendation_text:
• Reduce nitrogen fertilizer
• Apply balanced NPK fertilizer
• Add potassium to strengthen plant resistance
chemical_treatment_text:
Apply Isoprothiolane 40% EC
Dosage: 1.5ml per liter of water
Spray every 7 days if symptoms continue.
prevention_tips_text:
• Use resistant rice varieties
• Maintain field sanitation
• Avoid dense planting
• Monitor fields regularly
